title: Tianji Musings
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji watched the slowly dissipating wisp of soul in his hand, his smile gradually freezing. 'This time, let me save you.'

text.content: In the Void, the shattered Tianji Record emanated a faint glow. Chen Tianming's form was like a candle flame in the wind, wavering yet refusing to extinguish. He looked at the face before him, seven parts similar to his own, and suddenly laughed. "What are you standing there for?" Chen Tianming said gruffly, though his voice carried a hint of weakness. "Your father isn't dead yet. Come here and let me take a good look." Chen Ji walked forward slowly, his gaze falling on that familiar yet unfamiliar figure, his throat feeling choked.

dialogue.content: "Mm, you've grown taller." Chen Tianming eyed him up and down, then suddenly frowned. "But you've gotten thinner, and your face is darker—is the food at Tianqing Sect that bad? Or did you exchange spirit stones for wine again?"

Chen Ji felt a twitch at the corner of his mouth. "Father, your wisp of soul is almost gone, yet you're still worrying about what I eat?" He inhaled deeply, suppressing the surge of emotions. "Tell me about the fourth page of the Tianji Record. That multiple-choice question earlier—"

"Don't rush!" Chen Tianming waved his hand dismissively. "A wisp of spirit won't disappear immediately. Your father can still hold on for another quarter hour." His gaze softened slightly. "There's something I've kept bottled up for over a decade, and now I can finally say it face to face."

choice.prompt: Facing this sudden moment of warmth, Chen Ji chose...

choices.description: Now that Father is lucid, seize the opportunity to clarify the Tianji Record matter

dialogue.content: Chen Ji straightened his expression: "Father, explain the fourth page of the Tianji Record from the beginning. This concerns whether you can return—"
Chen Tianming sighed, a complex light flickering in his eyes: "Your temperament, exactly like mine when I was young—impatient to the core. Fine, fine, listen to me first."

choices.description: Father is难得 lucid for once, savor this hard-won father-son time
choices.visible_cost: Time is tight, might not finish asking

dialogue.content: Chen Ji inhaled deeply and sat down cross-legged: "Fine, take your time. How many chances do I get to hear you ramble in this lifetime anyway?"
Chen Tianming's eyes grew moist: "You rascal... Fine, today I'll let you hear enough!"

choices.description: Since Father still has strength for banter, let's see who's got a sharper tongue
choices.risk_hint: Risk getting verbally crushed even harder

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised an eyebrow: "Bad food? When you threw me into Tianqing Sect as a servant, I don't remember you ever worrying about my meals."
Chen Tianming froze, then burst into laughter: "Good lad, your tongue's gotten sharper! That little ghost who cried after I scolded him once, now knows how to talk back."

text.content: Chen Ji's face flushed slightly, yet he forced a calm demeanor: "That was sand in my eyes!"

dialogue.content: "Sand in your eyes?" Chen Tianming laughed so hard his wisp of soul trembled. "You were only five then, crying in the yard shouting 'Father's a bully' for a whole hour, your voice shaking the tiles on the roof!"
Chen Ji's temple throbbed: "Father! You're a wisp of soul, not a storyteller! Can you talk about something proper? Like what the fourth page of the Tianji Record actually is—"
"Proper?" Chen Tianming's laughter faded, his gaze deepening. "The proper truth is—the fourth page of the Tianji Record, your mother traded her life for."

text.content: The air seemed to freeze. Chen Ji stood stunned—that name, never met, mentioned only occasionally when Chen Tianming drank, now crashed into his mind with crushing weight. He opened his mouth, but no sound emerged. Chen Tianming sighed, the light of his wisp of soul dimming further.

dialogue.content: "Your mother was no ordinary person," Chen Tianming's voice was low. "She was the last bloodline of the Ancient Seers. The Tianji Record chose her, and chose me—but the seer's destiny is to become a chess piece of the Heavens. She refused, so..."

Chen Ji猛地抬头，眼中闪过一丝精光，恢复了那副算无遗策的神情："所以她把力量封入第四页，留给我？第四页既是击败天道之眼的关键，也是让您复生的钥匙——因为那是她的心血，蕴含着您当年的气息。" - Chen Ji lifted his head sharply, a gleam of insight flashing in his eyes, restoring his calculating expression: "So she sealed her power into the fourth page, leaving it for me? The fourth page is both the key to defeating the Heavenly Eye, and the key to your resurrection—because it's her life's blood, containing your aura from back then."

text.content: Chen Tianming gazed at his son with satisfaction: "You're smarter than I imagined. Truly my son, Chen Tianming's blood." He paused, his tone growing grave. "But the Heavenly Eye isn't so easily dealt with. It's existed for millions of years, devouring countless seers. If you want to win, you must go further than I did."

choice.prompt: As Father mentioned Mother and the Heavenly Eye, Chen Ji's heart churned, yet his face remained unmoved. He chose...

choices.description: Since Father brought up the topic voluntarily, clarify everything about Mother
choices.visible_cost: Might drain Father's wisp of soul
choices.visible_reward: Understand the truth of his origins
choices.risk_hint: The wisp of soul might dissipate faster

dialogue.content: Chen Ji inhaled deeply: "Father, Mother... where is she now? Has she really—"
Chen Tianming was silent for a moment, his voice hoarse: "Her soul... lies deep within the Heavenly Eye. But if you can defeat it, perhaps..."

text.content: Chen Ji's fists unconsciously tightened, yet his eyes turned cold as eternal ice. He didn't press further, merely silently recording this possibility in his heart.

choices.description: Put Mother's matters aside for now—the greatest enemy before us is the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Gain knowledge on how to oppose the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: Might miss crucial clues about Mother

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suppressed his churning emotions, his voice regained its calm: "The Heavenly Eye... where is it now? How strong is it?"

Chen Tianming nodded: "Good question. It is everywhere, yet leaves no trace. It feeds on the faith of all beings, uses Heavenly Fate as its chains. All those chosen by the Tianji Record are its prey."

text.content: Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly as the Tianji Record's aura flowed within him, seemingly confirming his father's words.

choices.description: Since the atmosphere is too heavy, use sarcasm to lighten it—this has always been his style
choices.visible_reward: Ease the atmosphere, gain more intelligence

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed: "So our family's genes literally have 'Targeted by Heaven' written in them? No wonder you ended up in such a sorry state back then."
Chen Tianming froze, then laughed and cursed: "You rascal! Your father was a generation's prodigy, how dare you speak like that?"

text.content: Yet a glimmer of amusement flickered in his eyes—this boy... truly has some of his flair.

dialogue.content: "Alright, alright," Chen Tianming waved his hand, the light of his wisp of soul dimming further. "Time is running out, let me be brief. The fourth page of the Tianji Record requires three things to unseal—your Heavenly Fate value, your sister Chen Nian's blood, and... a relic left by your mother."

"Chen Nian?" Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly, an obscure figure surfacing in his mind—the sister he'd searched for years yet never found. "She's in the Holy Sect's hands... Are you saying her existence has another meaning?"

"Chen Nian is the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key'," Chen Tianming's voice was heavy. "Her bloodline can open the chains of the Heavenly Eye—whether to seal it, or to release it. Those fools at the Holy Sect thought controlling her would give them leverage over Heaven, not knowing..."

text.content: "Not knowing they are the ones being manipulated by Heaven." Chen Ji picked up the thread, his eyes gleaming. "I understand. Father, anything else?" His tone was calm, yet the hand holding the Tianji Record trembled slightly—an excitement at touching the truth, and worry for his sister's predicament.

dialogue.content: Chen Tianming gazed at his son, then suddenly smiled with satisfaction: "That's it. One last word—you can cause more trouble than I could back then, good." He reached out, wanting to pat Chen Ji's shoulder, only to find his hand passing through his son's body.

text.content: Chen Ji froze, watching his father's wisp of soul hand pass through his shoulder—that touch was intangible, yet it made his nose sting. He inhaled deeply, forcefully suppressing the emotion, his face resuming its nonchalant smile.

choice.prompt: Facing his father's wisp of soul about to dissipate, Chen Ji wanted to say something...

choices.description: Rarely being serious, give Father a proper farewell
choices.visible_cost: Might get laughed at by Father
choices.risk_hint: The wisp of soul might dissipate faster

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly knelt, kowtowing deeply three times: "Father, your son has been unfilial, worrying you all these years. Rest assured—I will bring Chen Nian back, and bring Mother back too."

Chen Tianming was stunned, his eyes slightly reddening, yet he couldn't help but laugh and curse: "You rascal, making such a show..." His voice grew fainter, the light of his wisp of soul fading. "Remember, you are Chen Tianming's son... no one can..."

text.content: Before the words finished, Chen Tianming's wisp of soul dissipated like wind, leaving only a final warmth lingering around Chen Ji. On the first page of the Tianji Record, faint characters slowly appeared: 'My son, do not grieve, do not forget your original intention.'

choices.description: Since warmth isn't suitable for their father-son dynamic, farewell in the most Chen Ji way

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stood up, brushing the dust from his knees: "Alright, alright, I know you still have things unsaid. Rest assured, when have I ever let you down, Chen Ji?" He paused, adding quietly, "...Father, take care."

Chen Tianming laughed heartily, yet his wisp of soul gradually grew transparent amid the laughter: "You rascal... remember your words... I'll be in the heavens... watching how you get yourself killed..."

text.content: Before the words finished, that wisp of soul completely dissipated into the Void. The Tianji Record quivered gently, and new characters appeared on the first page—a final message from Chen Tianming.
On the first page of the Tianji Record, characters slowly appeared: 'You can cause more trouble than I could back then, good. Do not forget your original intention, my son.'

choices.description: Some words don't need to be spoken; silence is the best farewell
choices.risk_hint: Might miss the final chance to communicate

text.content: Chen Ji said nothing, merely watching silently as his father's form dissipated bit by bit. His expression was terrifyingly calm, as if observing something unrelated. Yet the hand gripping the Tianji Record was clenched tight, knuckles white.

dialogue.content: Chen Tianming looked at his son's expression and suddenly sighed: "Your temperament... exactly like her mother, keeping everything bottled up." His voice grew fainter. "That's fine. A man should be like this."

text.content: The moment the wisp of soul completely dissipated, Chen Ji finally spoke softly: "...I understand." His voice was soft, yet carried unprecedented determination. On the Tianji Record, Chen Tianming's characters slowly appeared, as if responding to this silence.

Silence returned to the Void, leaving only the faint glow of the Tianji Record. Chen Ji slowly stood up, gazing down at the fragment in his hand. Father's words still echoed: Heavenly Fate Lock-Key, Heavenly Eye, Mother's relic...这一切交织在一起，勾勒出一个庞大而危险的棋局。 All this intertwined, outlining a massive and dangerous chess game.

He suddenly smiled—that smile carried a trace of mockery, a trace of self-mockery, and an inexplicable tenderness. "Cause more trouble than you could?" Chen Ji murmured to himself, storing the Tianji Record in his chest. "Father, you're really... overestimating me."

He turned to gaze into the Void, his eyes flashing with a sharp light. Holy Sect, Heavenly Eye, Chen Nian—all of it awaits him. And now, he finally has a clear direction. "The fourth page..." Chen Ji clenched his fist. "I will unseal it myself. This time, let me save you all."

The Tianji Record quivered gently, as if responding to his determination. On the first page, Chen Tianming's characters slowly faded, replaced by new text—a clue to the fourth page, and his father's final gift.

Chen Ji gazed at those characters, a familiar arc curving at the corner of his mouth. "Interesting." He murmured, his eyes growing sharper. "Father, Mother, Chen Nian—wait for me." With that, he strode toward the Void, his form gradually merging into the Tianji Record's light, awaiting the next trial of fate.
